eras.title: Computerization & Centralization
eras.desc: Transition from local regional ledgers to core computerized databases.

eras.title: UAN & Digital India Leap
eras.desc: Launch of the Universal Account Number (UAN) and nationwide Aadhaar seeding.

eras.title: Mobile Services & Ease of Business
eras.desc: UMANG app services, automated claim settlement, and ECR 2.0 electronic returns.

eras.title: COVID-19 Emergency Relief
eras.desc: Special non-refundable pandemic advances and PMGKY contribution subsidies.

eras.title: Higher Pension Watershed
eras.desc: Implementation of Supreme Court judgment on higher pension and online joint options.

eras.title: Next-Gen CITES 2.0 & Statutory Reform
eras.desc: CITES 2.0 architecture revamp, Code on Social Security 2020, and Amnesty 2026.

milestones.title: National Database & Core Centralization
milestones.summary: Initiation of central electronic data interchange and national subscriber database consolidation.
milestones.impact: Layed the structural groundwork for portable account numbers across regional offices.

milestones.title: Declaration of Historic 9.50% Interest Rate
milestones.summary: Central Board approved 9.50% interest rate credited into member accounts for 2010-11.
milestones.impact: Highest declared interest rate in recent EPFO operational history.

milestones.title: Launch of Universal Account Number (UAN)
milestones.summary: Mandated a single permanent UAN for every contributing employee across job changes.
milestones.impact: Eliminated repetitive manual PF account transfers during job switches for millions of workers.

milestones.title: Aadhaar Seeding & Digital Life Certificates
milestones.summary: Integration of Aadhaar with UAN and Jeevan Pramaan biometric verification for pensioners.
milestones.impact: Pensioners no longer required physical visits to bank branches for annual life certificates.

milestones.title: Employees' Enrolment Campaign 2017
milestones.summary: Special amnesty and compliance drive encouraging voluntary declaration of unorganized workers.
milestones.impact: Over 10 million previously informal workers enrolled into formal social security coverage.

milestones.title: Mobile Passbook & Services on UMANG App
milestones.summary: Rollout of e-passbook viewing, claim submission, and pension tracking on mobile handsets.
milestones.impact: Transformed EPFO from counter-based field office queues into a 24x7 smartphone self-service.

milestones.title: Standardized Audit of Private Exempted Trusts
milestones.summary: Introduced strict computerized compliance and investment guidelines for private PF trusts.
milestones.impact: Protected retirement savings of millions of employees in large private corporate trusts.

milestones.title: Emergency COVID-19 Non-Refundable Advance
milestones.summary: Notified emergency amendment allowing up to 75% non-refundable advance during national lockdowns.
milestones.impact: Disbursed tens of thousands of crores in emergency liquidity within 72 hours of application.

milestones.title: PMGKY Government Contribution Subvention
milestones.summary: Government paid complete 24% employer and employee PF contributions for small businesses.
milestones.impact: Prevented mass layoffs in micro, small, and medium enterprises during pandemic disruptions.

milestones.title: Supreme Court Higher Pension Landmark Ruling
milestones.summary: Supreme Court upheld validity of 2014 EPS amendments while granting window for higher wage options.
milestones.impact: Enabled over 1.7 million employees to apply for higher monthly pension calculations.

milestones.title: Standard Operating Procedure on Joint Declarations
milestones.summary: Completely digitized the member profile correction process (name, DOB, father's name, DOJ).
milestones.impact: Drastically reduced rejection of claim settlements caused by demographic discrepancies.

milestones.title: Online Portal for Joint Options Validation
milestones.summary: Deployed automated backend for employers and field offices to validate pension on higher wages.
milestones.impact: Standardized the wage verification and differential contribution transfer calculations.

milestones.title: Code on Social Security 2020 Officer Notification
milestones.summary: Notified authorized officers to initiate proceedings under Section 125 & 128 of the Social Security Code.
milestones.impact: Operational milestone transitioning statutory compliance to the modern Code on Social Security.

milestones.title: Launch of AMNESTY 2026 & VISHWAS 2026
milestones.summary: Dual regularisation schemes for unexempted private trusts and dispute settlement on 14B damages.
milestones.impact: Fast-tracked resolution of long-standing employer disputes and trust regularizations.

milestones.title: Next-Gen CITES 2.01 & Automated Interest Credit
milestones.summary: Deployment of CITES 2.01 with prompt 8.25% annual interest credit automation across accounts.
milestones.impact: Significantly shortened account settlement turnarounds and eliminated annual interest credit lags.
